slug: 2025-10-13 Comesa payment system connects Malawi, Zambia

facts.fact: COMESA's Digital Retail Payments Platform is stated to be rolled out, linking Malawi and Zambia for instant local-currency cross-border transactions.
Malawi takes part in the COMESA Digital Retail Payments Platform, described as the first interoperable cross-border payment system of the 21-member bloc.
